title: Beaumont Kin
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: Though he once aspired to be an educator and instead became an historian, Beaumont Kin found himself working with the Resistance in their struggle against the First Order, becoming a captain in the intelligence division. When it was revealed that Palpatine had returned, he posited it was because of cloning, dark science, and secrets only the Sith knew.
